content: Image storage for small self-hosted apps: two defensible options. Filesystem + path/metadata in DB = better serving performance, OS caching, but orphan risk and separate backup. DB BLOB = atomic transactions with metadata, single-file backup, no orphans; HN consensus that BLOBs work well for small projects, especially SQLite. Either way serve images through the authenticated app route, not raw static files, when access control matters; downscale client-side before upload.
